preconditions.description: The number of sentences T is between 1 and 100.
The Bytelandian to English mapping string M has exactly 26 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in M)
preconditions.description: The Bytelandian to English mapping string M contains only lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(len(S) > 0 and len(S) <= 100 for S in sentences)
preconditions.description: Each sentence S is non-empty and contains at most 100 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_.,!?') for c in S) for S in sentences)
preconditions.description: Each sentence S contains only lowercase letters, uppercase letters, underscores, and punctuation symbols.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of input sentences T.

postconditions.expression: all(translate_sentence(S, M) == output_lines[i] for i, S in enumerate(sentences))
postconditions.description: Each output line is the English translation of the corresponding input sentence S using the mapping M.
